source_references.title: Berkeley SoftFloat: software IEEE arithmetic methodology (no code copied)

canonical_equations: a=-mu*rvec/r^3+(3/2)*J2*mu*R^2/r^5 * [x*(5*z^2/r^2-1),y*(5*z^2/r^2-1),z*(5*z^2/r^2-3)]; exact RN32 order in contract.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; positions[N,3],N1..4096; mu>=0,reference_radius>=0,finite j2; coherent units supplied by caller; finite RN32 intermediates.
output_contract: N x [u32 status,f32 ax,ay,az]; status1 when rounded radius squared is zero with mu>0, then zero acceleration; mu=0 yields status0 zero force. No collision/body-surface or atmosphere model.
result_contract: N x [u32 status,f32 ax,ay,az]; status1 when rounded radius squared is zero with mu>0, then zero acceleration; mu=0 yields status0 zero force. No collision/body-surface or atmosphere model.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
